pr_title: fix(chromium): do not pre-populate non-preflight OPTIONS requests
pr_comments: Shall we also make sure that `page.on('request')` is able to read the response body or not related / important?

issue_context.title: [BUG] Failing to intercept API requests
comments: I'm thinking maybe it has something to do with a mixed domain scenario? The login takes place on another domain than where the rest of the application lives (and of which I want to log API calls and later mock the responses).

> After logging in, the OPTIONS request on /api/ returns a 204 No content instead of a 200 with Hypermedia links to all other accessible APIs.

I think this is the most probable culprit. However, we'd really need more information to be able to help. Ideally, a publicly accessible page that has this issue. Or at least [a trace file](https://playwright.dev/docs/trace-viewer-intro).

Hmm interesting. It indeed seems to have nothing to do with a cross-domain scenario. Even if I use two separate browser contexts (one for logging in and saving storage state, and the other for restoring storage state and using the application/frontend on the other domain, with request interception), the problem still persists.

Apparently the server doesn't trust the API requests as soon as they're intercepted by Playwright? 

I will try your advice and come back to you. Might take a while though, I'm doing this as a pet project.

@eveltman-twinfield Intercepting OPTIONS preflight requests is full of intricate details. I assume Playwright doesn't do quite the same as your server. That's why I'm interested in a repro - perhaps we would be able to figure out something specific in your setup that Playwright misses.

Hi, @dgozman, I just sent you an e-mail (on the e-mail address you use for GitHub commits) with details to access the application. If you don't receive it, let me know. I hope this will enable you to reproduce the issue.
I managed to reproduce. It seems like we are intercepting non-preflight OPTIONS and supply an empty body, which breaks this particular page.
Thank you for the fast fix. I'll try it out as soon as I can. (But last few days I'm a bit too busy)
